name: HiAndromon
main_effect:
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By placing 1 8000 DP or lower Digimon as the bottom security card, trash your opponent's top security card.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your [Ver.3] trait Digimon would leave the battle area, by trashing your top security card, they don't leave.
source_effect: Ace Overflow ＜-4＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
